title: Sequoia, OpenAI and Citadel Securities Launch $100K Poker Bot Tournament
summary:
Teams of one or two university students and recent graduates will compete to develop poker bots from scratch within 60 minutes as part of a new competition called No Limit. The tournament, hosted by Sequoia, Citadel Securities and OpenAI, will start with regional qualifying events in Boston, Pittsburgh and the Bay Area in early November. The five top-performing teams from each region will advance to the finals to compete for a $100K grand prize.

The competition's strict time limit is a response to the increased efficiency of modern AI tools. While a similar annual course at MIT previously required a month for students to build poker AIs, participants in the new tournament will utilize coding agents to complete the process in a single hour. The event is open to current students and those who graduated in 2025 or 2026.
